title: Create sealed device keys
responsibility: Create a device's P-256 key-agreement and signing pairs and its public chain view.

inputs.name: sealedDevice.options
inputs.description: Key extractability option. Defaults to non-extractable private keys.

inputs.name: sealedDevicePublic.keys
inputs.description: Device ID and key pairs to represent in the chain.

inputs.name: sealedDevicePublic.role
inputs.description: Role to record for the device.

inputs.name: sealedDevicePublic.scopes
inputs.description: Scope identifiers to record for the device.

outputs.name: sealedDevice
outputs.description: Fresh device identity, key-agreement and signing pairs, and raw public keys.

outputs.name: sealedDevicePublic
outputs.description: Chain-ready public record with encoded public keys and sorted scopes.
